instructions: Fill views with actual current bound PNG/raw/metadata records and their SHA256 after the batch. No placeholders may enter a fit.

Single-camera K/D and pixel reprojection residuals do not need a metric square length. The existing API calls its uniform scale field square_mm;1.0 here explicitly denotes one grid square, not a physical millimeter.

No metric translation, baseline or object dimension may be claimed from this unit-square dataset. The current single-eye profile exports K/D, not metric extrinsics; any later stereo board definition must carry its own correct unit.
The board label15mm remains nominal and unmeasured; this is recorded rather than used as a fitting prerequisite.

80deg is a requested forward-ray support interval, not an estimated/measured200deg lens field. Numerical domain and held-out checks may reject it; any narrower candidate must state its crop/support explicitly.
Keep the unchanged minimum12 distinct training poses plus3 held-out views and the required source-image3x3 coverage gates. Only training images fit K/D.

Preserve each explicit physical pose and split; collector holdout is translated explicitly to calibrator held_out. Do not infer split or novelty from frame number/filename; static duplicates remain one pose.
Do not automatically reuse the earlier T01 image as an extra pose if the new batch already contains T01. Select at most one good image per declared pose; retain all originals.
The original same-pose pair has complete88-corner detection but contributes central coverage only. Additional edge and independent held-out coverage is still required.
